A.note: Strong blue sky, warm sun, saturated sea and a rocky, shaded mountain. The airport apron and the white blocks in the foreground read as flat untextured grey.

B.note: Hazy, low-contrast and pale. The mountain is smeared and blurry with a snow-like texture. The orange roofs pop, but the whole frame looks like a flat map.

C.note: Almost identical to A. The distant headland is dark green, which adds depth but looks slightly odd, and the sea is slightly more saturated. The foreground is still flat grey.

D.note: Same as B, with a hazy grey-white sky and a smeared mountain. It has a little less roof colour than B and is the flattest of the four.

why: A and C have real sky, contrast, shaded rock and saturated sea, so they look cinematic. B and D are washed out and the mountain texture is muddy.
top_fix_for_best: Add texture and variation to the foreground airport apron and the white building blocks. Use asphalt and concrete detail, roof variation and ambient-occlusion shadows. Then add a few aircraft, vehicles or people so the scale reads clearly.
